answer_1.quote: We tackle the challenging task of figurative language generation: hyperbole generation from literal sentences ... We propose an unsupervised approach to generate hyperbolic paraphrase from literal input.
answer_1.outputs: hyperbolic paraphrases (hyperbolic sentences) generated from literal inputs

answer_2.quote: We use the 71 literal sentences (para) in the test set of HYPO dataset as test inputs and their corresponding hyperbolic sentences (hypo) as gold references. We report the BLEU and BERTScore metrics for generated sentences compared against human written hyperboles.

answer_3.quote: We leverage the BERT-based hyperbole detection model fine‑tuned on HYPO and HYPO‑L to assign a hyperbole score (i.e., prediction probability) for each candidate. We also train a pairwise model (distilled RoBERTa‑base) to predict whether hyperbolic sentence A is a paraphrase of literal sentence B, providing a paraphrase score for ranking.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the generation results from the 71 testing literal sentences. Each pair of texts (ours vs. a baseline / human reference) is given preference (win, lose or tie) by five people with proficiency in English. We use a set of four criteria adapted from prior work: Fluency, Hyperbolicity, Creativity, Relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judge each output on four criteria (fluency, hyperbolicity, creativity, relevance) and indicate win/lose/tie.
